messages:
clara: FYI seeing a spike in client reconnects in EU canary (03:14 UTC). Console shows lots of "session-lost" traces but backend tcp/keepalive shows no closes. Suspect proxy keepalive behavior.

mike: Can you paste a sample request/response? curl or tcpdump would help. Also which proxy version is on canary?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: proxy/v2.3.1-keepalive (tag: keepalive-204) at 2026-03-22T03:12:09Z

tian: I pulled a capture. Proxy is returning intermittent "HTTP/1.1 204 No Content" with Transfer-Encoding: chunked as a keepalive flush. Our SSE parser treats that as an empty event and sometimes advances state to terminal close in the client polyfills.

clara: exact example from capture:

```
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
X-Proxy-Keepalive: 1
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

0


```

mike: ahh. Many EventSource polyfills consider a blank chunk as stream end. Are our clients using eventsource polyfills or native EventSource in Safari/old chrome?

andrea: Most mobile SDKs use a small cross-platform polyfill (eventsource-shim). I can check versioning matrix. If polyfill misinterprets a 0-length chunk as end-of-stream we'll see reconnects.

tian: Another problem: resume tokens aren't getting annotated when a keepalive 204 hits the proxy path. Our telemetry sampling filters drop resume markers on those sessions, which could cause duplicate billing when clients resume after reconnect (no server-side dedupe). We need a low-cost metric now: sse.proxy.keepalive.count and sse.proxy.keepalive.resume-missed.count

clara: Proposed short-term mitigation: proxy should set a header `X-SSE-Keepalive: keepalive` not 204, or at least not send chunked 0-length frames. Long-term: make server and client parsers tolerant of 204/0-chunk by ignoring those frames unless followed by actual data within N ms.

mike: For a quick canary patch we can special-case header `X-Proxy-Keepalive: 1` and have our edge SDK treat it as noop. Patch snippet idea:

```
if (status == 204 && headers['x-proxy-keepalive']) {
  // treat as keepalive, do NOT close eventsource
  continue;
}
```

and add server-side telemetry: `sse.proxy.keepalive.ignored` every time.

andrea: I'll open a PR labelled `eng-platform/sse-keepalive-hotfix`. Can someone add tests for polyfill behavior (node eventsource-shim) and a unit for console metric mapping?

deploy-bot: Rollout note: canary has been at 12% EU traffic since 03:10Z.

clara: If we can't get a hotfix in <2h I'll request rollback of proxy/v2.3.1-keepalive. Oncall/ops pinged.

ops: oncall here, acked. I'll monitor `sse.reconnect.rate` and be ready to roll back. :thumbsup:

mike: added the metric names to infra ticket #4982 and set a dashboard row for `sse.proxy.keepalive.ignored` and `sse.proxy.keepalive.resume-missed`. Please verify sampling is low cost.

clara: thanks — assigned to andrea/tian. please post PR and I'll review. :eyes:
